market_note: Stablecoin supply has shed $15B since May, 2026's biggest decline since Terra's collapse, as GENIUS Act interest bans push cash into tokenized Treasuries.

stablecoin_items.headline: Stablecoin supply posts biggest drop since Terra
stablecoin_items.summary: Total supply fell over $15B from a mid-May peak of $322B as GENIUS Act rules barring yield on payment stablecoins pushed cash into tokenized Treasuries. USDT and USDC absorbed most of the decline.

stablecoin_items.headline: OCC issues proposed rules to implement GENIUS Act
stablecoin_items.summary: The OCC published a notice of proposed rulemaking covering issuance and licensing requirements for payment stablecoin issuers, a major step in formalizing the July 2025 law.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether and Circle battle for share as new rival emerges
stablecoin_items.summary: Circle's Arc chain is moving to proof-of-stake and courting institutions, while Stripe, Visa, BlackRock and 140+ firms back a new rival, Open USD (OUSD); Circle shares fell 13% on the news.

stablecoin_items.headline: Tether's USAT grows but still trails USDC, PYUSD, RLUSD
stablecoin_items.summary: Tether's US-focused stablecoin USAT is scaling for institutional treasury and settlement use, but remains far smaller than Circle's ~$72B USDC and other regulated rivals.

hack_items.headline: Coldcard hardware wallet flaw drains $116M in BTC
hack_items.summary: A 2021 firmware bug routed seed generation to a predictable software RNG instead of the hardware RNG; attackers have swept over 4,500 wallets in successive waves since July 30. Coinkite has shipped emergency firmware.

hack_items.headline: Ethereum phishing scam drains nearly $1M from a single wallet
hack_items.summary: A targeted phishing attack tricked a victim into signing a malicious transaction, draining close to $1M in ETH-based assets in one hit.

hack_items.headline: KelpDAO's $292M LayerZero bridge hack still reverberating
hack_items.summary: The April cross-chain exploit, linked to North Korea's Lazarus Group, triggered a $9B panic withdrawal from Aave after attackers used stolen funds as loan collateral, exposing systemic DeFi contagion risk.

hack_items.headline: H1 2026 sets record for crypto hack frequency
hack_items.summary: Q2 2026 logged roughly 70 separate exploits, the most-hacked quarter on record, though total losses stayed below $1B as recovery efforts improved.
